caption: the last heat the soul - 84 shinigami, tag battles and the ad-hoc law that kept japan playing.
about: Bleach: heat the soul 7 (2010) closes eighting's psp fighting line with the biggest roster the series saw: eighty-four characters from the arrancar arc onward, 2v2 tag battles built around rapid swaps and layered combos, and the ad-hoc multiplayer that made it a schoolyard standard in japan. It is the definitive bleach fighter on any platform.
No windows build exists, so the platform is psp - played through ppsspp, rom sourced from romsfun.
